correctness.rationale: The proof is symbolic for all h>=3 and all level sizes at least two. The image-level lemma forces every noncontractible image to meet every level in at least two points and hence forces level preservation; all other images contain a singleton ordinal-sum factor and are contractible. The join-homology tensor argument makes every level-preserving nonconstant map homologically nonzero, and pointwise comparability then forces equality. Exhaustive small cases agree with the theorem but are not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a complete, closed-form self-homotopy classification for every finite weak order with at least three nontrivial levels. It is structurally motivated by pseudospheres/ordinal sums, not an arbitrary finite slice, and reveals a strong mapping-space dichotomy: all homologically trivial maps collapse into one null class while every remaining map is rigid. The formula scales uniformly with all level sizes and is not a mere recomputation of a known table.
